volume.forecast_clock: daily 00:00 UTC, completed source bars only
volume.target: log(sum of squared log(close/open) over next 3 held 8h bars starting 08:00 UTC plus 1e-12); coarse OHLCV volatility proxy, not tick realized variance
volume.baseline: log prior daily proxy, log mean prior7 daily proxies, log mean prior30 daily proxies, log prior BTC daily proxy, ETH and LINK dummies (SOL reference)
volume.extra_feature: log(prior UTC day typical-price times base-volume sum divided by mean of preceding30 daily sums, INCLUDING prior day); turnover proxy, not actual quote volume
volume.estimator: training-only StandardScaler and Ridge(alpha=1,intercept=true,solver=svd), equal symbol-day weights
volume.gates: minimum156 shared calendar weeks; >=1% pooled MSE reduction; 99% bootstrap lower>0; each symbol improvement>0; two of 2023/2024/2025 positive; every leave-year pooled improvement>0
volume.dependence: UTC Monday weekly clusters across symbols/days; circular4week bootstrap2000 seed20261010, descriptive
volume.controls: one-day-delayed volume feature model (first forecast unavailable, no imputation);500 within-year28-day block permutations of extended-minus-baseline contribution, same mapping across symbols, fixed short tails; seed20261010; descriptive only
volume.decision: failure rejects as specified; passing means development-only state information, requires separate economic application protocol; no direction rule or trading/PnL evaluator in this study

minute.source: Binance official public Spot daily 1m klines ZIP and CHECKSUM; exact raw bytes and receipt times retained
minute.universe: same BTC/ETH/SOL/LINK panel; fixed without PnL selection; large liquid panel adaptation, not small-cap paper replication
minute.validation: checksum match;1440 strictly continuous UTC minute opens per symbol/date; matching panel grids; complete finite positive OHLC, nonnegative volumes/trade counts; ms before2025/us from2025 normalized explicitly; no filling/trimming/substitution
minute.lead_diagnostic: within each date Pearson correlation BTC close-to-close return(t) with alt(t) and alt(t+1), boundaries never crossed; observational only; no pooled cross-gap training or significance gate
minute.movement_diagnostic: per symbol/date absolute close-to-close move bps distribution and fraction above60bps roundtrip assumption; magnitude is not predictive/executable expectancy
minute.execution: one current20-level Binance public book snapshot per symbol, fixed1000USDT buy then sell walk; require both sides sufficient; record spread, depth cost and receipt age; current snapshot cannot calibrate historical slippage, latency or actual account fees
minute.decision: complete data panel passes source-access feasibility only; missing archive/checksum/invalid data blocks entire historical assessment; no predictor or strategy economics; full continuous sample and execution design required before any future lead-lag test
